provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Zharvokh is centered at 73.587529, -60.833104 under Military Regency, with 26,890,000 people across 9 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Zharvokh occupies  sq mi /  sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory. Its province terrain is led by Mountain range, Deep cavern, Hybrid tree and forest floor. Karag-Thûl, Kharévok, Moltharok, and Tharvokar carry the mountain record: Karag-Thûl occupies the whole mountain section it sits within and descends into caverns with underworld rumors, Kharévok sits between two ranges, Moltharok clings to a mountain side, and Tharvokar is deep mountain.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Dwarven and Gnomish Kin, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Dwarf — Mountain Dwarf, Dwarf — Duergar, Gnome — Deep Gnome, Elf — Drow, Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Dwarf — Hill Dwarf, Gnome — Rock Gnome, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Cog-Sanctum Synod, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Iskareth, Marduthor, Bastveig, Setrimir, Sigrananna, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 21 recorded four-province geography group links, including 18 cross-transportation-group links. These links place it inside overlapping regional corridors rather than one isolated block, allowing border-adjacent transit, faction influence, and cultural spillover to breathe across group lines.
mountainSettlementNotes: Karag-Thûl: Karag-Thûl takes up the entire section of mountain range it sits within, and its lowest caverns carry underworld access rumors.
Kharévok: Kharévok is situated between two mountain ranges.
Moltharok: Moltharok is perched on the side of the mountain.
Tharvokar: Tharvokar is a deep mountain city in Zharvokh.
